keyframes.label: 14 Aug 2018 00:00 (Onset)
keyframes.summary: Initial satellite observation from Sentinel-1 SAR. Heavy rainfall initiated dam discharges.

keyframes.label: 15 Aug 2018 12:00 (Data Gap)
keyframes.note: No satellite pass in this window; extent shown is last-confirmed + bounded growth estimate, not a new observation.

keyframes.label: 17 Aug 2018 00:00 (Peak Flood)
keyframes.summary: Peak flood extent captured by Dartmouth Flood Observatory. Critical emergency level across Alappuzha & Kottayam.
